upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.12: client operations 79 -> 107 (GET /folders folder statistics; /users/me/playlists list, create, read, update, delete and entries list, append, remove, move; /users/me/favorites/persons list, read, PUT, DELETE; GET /media/{id}/similar; GET /users/me/recommendations/recent-plays; GET /episodes/upcoming and /episodes/missing; PUT /users/me/media/{id}/played; GET and PUT /users/me/media/{id}/seasons/{season}/state; GET, HEAD, PUT, DELETE /users/me/avatar; POST .../delete aliases for the new DELETE operations). Media adds required tags and has_poster; PlaybackSession adds required file_size, bitrate_bps and content_revision; GET /media and GET /media/initials add has_poster, tag_ids and tag_exclude_ids; sort adds last_added_desc; facet kinds add tags. Capability features add user_playlists, folder_statistics, favorite_persons, media_has_poster, similar_media, recent_play_recommendations, episode_schedule, series_played_state, season_state, user_avatar, media_last_added_sort, media_tags and administration_media_tags, with 13 new limits. The Kit subset check accepts the new player root /folders. No typed SDK schema change.
